title: The palette has a Layout menu of split actions
body:
`Layout` in `src/panes.rs` holds the split tree. Today the bar can zoom a pane, a drag can resize, swap or insert panes, and Ctrl+Shift+Enter adds a terminal pane.

## Proposal

The Layout menu has these rows, each acting on the focused pane or the split that holds it:

- Equalize sets every split's ratio so each pane gets an even share.
- Rotate turns the focused pane's split from side by side to stacked, or back.
- Swap exchanges the two sides of that split.
- Zoom toggles zoom on the focused pane.
- New terminal does what Ctrl+Shift+Enter does.
